'''Kyvax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] who was employed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. His job was to construct [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-bombs that were to be used in an attack on the settlement of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Kyvax carried out this task at the [[Northern Windfarm]], a location in Tatooine's [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. However, a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] investigated the situation and fought against Kyvax's fellow Geonosians on the windfarm in order to stop them. Kyvax himself was killed by the [[Havoc Squad]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].
